text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Black Creek Drive and Weston Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for pedestrian crossing protection at the southbound and westbound right-turn channels at the intersection of Black Creek Drive and Weston Road. Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services is recommending the installation of a pedestrian crossover (PXO) at these locations. The PXOs will provide enhanced safety for vulnerable road users. During the course of the investigation, it was noted that there is a discrepancy between posted signs and the yield sign regulations. Recommendation 2 will correct this inconsistency.

City Council on June 24 and 25, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of two pedestrian crossovers at the right-turn channels at the northwest and northeast corners of the intersection of Black Creek Drive and Weston Road. 2. City Council authorize two yield controls on the right-turn channels at the northwest and northeast intersections of Black Creek Drive and Weston Road.
